title: bostec.service-link.v1
description: Frozen paired product contract. This schema defines public shapes; authority, snapshot equality, hashes, expiry, set ordering and durable transitions are additionally enforced by runtime validators. The schema URI is an identifier, not a discoverable production service.

x-resource-constraints.empty_or_null_means: No standalone authority and never a wildcard. Guided callback request/task arrays may be empty only when every accepted execution has the exact approved durable link/peer/revision stamp and real request/execution acknowledgement; nonempty arrays further narrow that recorded set.
x-resource-constraints.rateldesk.incident-create.v1: organization_id and the explicitly enabled customer_ids bind source membership; current receiver supports one approved customer per source namespace.
x-resource-constraints.rateldesk.orchestration.callback.v1: organization_id must match the local organization. Manual clients require nonempty recorded local request_ids/task_ids. Guided clients require task OrchestrationLinkId/OrchestrationPeerInstanceId/OrchestrationLinkRevision equal the approved link and exact recorded external request/execution correlation; optional nonempty request_ids/task_ids/customer_ids further narrow that bound set. No unrelated task authority.
x-resource-constraints.netratel.orchestration.v1: tenant_id plus nonempty explicitly approved resource_ids and/or request_definition_ids, under current FlowExecutionAuthority; organization_id is null and customer_ids/request_ids/task_ids are empty in this frozen product profile. No unrelated tenant enumeration or unrestricted ingest.

x-hash.numeric_domain: nonnegative safe integer; larger identifiers are strings
